content: The sentence "Robin Lehner launched the desperation heave" is plausible. Robin Lehner is a professional ice hockey goaltender, and while goaltenders rarely take shots on the opposing net, it is a known, albeit rare, occurrence in situations where a team has pulled their goalie for an extra attacker and is desperately trying to score. A "desperation heave" accurately describes a long, hopeful shot taken under such circumstances.
